documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Policy
documents.quality_note: Formal university policy covering teaching, learning, research and administration.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence at Augusta University
documents.quality_note: Student and faculty guidance: follow syllabus, disclose AI use, privacy and risk guidance, instructors should set clear policies.

documents.title: Academic Honesty policy
documents.quality_note: Long integrity policy; AI appears in the definitions of cheating/plagiarism (no AI-generated text without explicit instructor permission).

notes: School of Computer and Cyber Sciences (augusta.edu/ccs) has no AI policy page; its AI/ML page is a research-group listing. Medical College of Georgia has a student GenAI policy (v2-augusta-mcg-ai.txt) but it is a medical-school policy, not computing, so not listed.
